name: V360
description: Converts 360 degree video between projections (equirect, cubemap, eac, fisheye, flat...) with rotation, like FFmpeg's v360.

params.name: input
params.description: Input projection: 0 equirect, 1 cube3x2, 2 cube6x1, 3 cube1x6, 4 eac, 5 flat, 6 dfisheye, 7 fisheye, 8 stereographic, 9 mercator, 10 ball, 11 hammer, 12 sinusoidal, 13 pannini, 14 cylindrical, 15 cylindricalea, 16 equisolid, 17 orthographic, 18 octahedron, 19 hequirect

params.name: output
params.description: Output projection, same numbering as input

params.name: rorder
params.description: Rotation order: 0 ypr, 1 yrp, 2 pyr, 3 pry, 4 ryp, 5 rpy

params.name: h_fov
params.description: Output horizontal field of view in degrees, 0 = default of the projection (flat and cylindrical 90, fisheye like 180, others 360). For pannini it is the `d` factor of the projection, not degrees (default 360, as FFmpeg)

params.name: v_fov
params.description: Output vertical field of view in degrees, 0 = default of the projection (flat and cylindrical 45, fisheye like 180, others 180)

params.name: d_fov
params.description: Output diagonal field of view in degrees; when above 0 it replaces h_fov and v_fov using the frame size

params.name: ih_fov
params.description: Input horizontal field of view in degrees, 0 = default of the projection; for pannini it is the `d` factor, not degrees

params.name: iv_fov
params.description: Input vertical field of view in degrees, 0 = default of the projection

params.name: id_fov
params.description: Input diagonal field of view in degrees; when above 0 it replaces ih_fov and iv_fov

params.name: background
params.description: Fill for pixels the output projection or the input does not cover
